d: Deep navy blue hair is styled into a high ponytail with long bangs framing the face, paired with sharp, deep navy blue eyes and a cheerful expression. The face appears that of a teenager with a slender build. The outfit consists of a seafoam green kimono wrap over a dark navy blue pleated skirt, accented by a red obi belt and brown fingerless gloves. Signature details include two white hair ornaments and large, grey mechanical aircraft carrier riggings equipped with flight decks and aircraft attached to the back and sides.
